label: B25-RX-PHYSICAL-OBSERVABILITY
title: Add self-reporting physical JTAG-UART RX observability to the B25 monitor
triggered_by: Vendor-timed Avalon/bridge/monitor simulation passes while the corrected board candidate still fails after explicit standard-server rescans
writes: rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv::lcvex_catapult_soc_jtag_uart counters, status wiring and lcvex_catapult_soc_status decode
related direct module test instantiations only as required by the new ports
scripts/test_registry.json only if a new stable test entry is added
scope: Count completed JTAG DATA reads in the production bridge; count and latch DATA.RVALID/last-byte observations; expose them through read-only PLAT_STATUS offsets without changing the public SoC top ports. The BRAM monitor emits RXDBG <read_count_hex> <event_word_hex> immediately after READY and periodically every 0x40000 empty polls, so a terminal can distinguish CPU-alive/polling, no-Avalon-RX, and observed-byte cases without receiving a command.

register_contract.0x09003010: bits31:16 wrapping RVALID count, bit8 RX-seen sticky, bits7:0 last received byte; other bits zero
register_contract.reset: All new counters, sticky state and last byte reset to zero with logic rst_n
register_contract.update: Only on the bridge cycle that completes an accepted DATA read; RVALID fields update only when captured readdata[15] is one

acceptance.focused: Icarus and Verilator prove reset values, empty-read counting, exactly-once RVALID counting, last-byte/sticky behavior, wrap behavior and no CONTROL/write side effects under behavioral and vendor timing.
acceptance.status: Directed status-register tests prove +0/+8/+0x10 decode, read-only behavior, response stability under backpressure and unchanged calibration bits/version.
acceptance.monitor: Built ELF/HEX/MIF stay coherent; simulation observes the exact startup RXDBG zero snapshot, periodic telemetry after 0x40000 empty polls, and unchanged PONG/status/echo semantics.
acceptance.regression: Behavioral and vendor-timed full-SoC, affected L0-L2, synthesis selector and registry checks pass; assertions and expected command behavior are not relaxed.
acceptance.release: A separate integration task must run Gate D. Only then may a fresh physical/assembler/volatile-board chain be registered.

resource: Static/Icarus work is light. Verilator full-SoC and affected heavy suites acquire local; any later Quartus stage acquires gamepc in a separate task. This task itself performs no Quartus or board action.
forbidden_regions: JTAG address alias or RISC-V/VexRiscv workaround
Quartus, assembler, JTAG, Flash, reset or power actions

result.vendor_full_soc: PASS; 262,144 empty reads, 2,359,302 commits, periodic/dynamic RXDBG and PONG/status/echo
result.bram_oracle: PASS; 13/13 negative faults plus task-TMPDIR Verilator heavy run
